$comment: Self-tuning values for the scheduled checks. nightly.* is read by .github/workflows/nightly-compliance.yml on every run. scripts/auto-qa-tuner.mjs (.github/workflows/auto-qa.yml, weekly) reads what the last nightly runs measured and proposes new values, always inside each value's min and max. It never commits: a proposal goes into one tracking issue and a person or agent applies it in a pull request. rules.* controls the tuner itself and is not tuned.

image_max_age_days.note: The nightly fails when ghcr.io/danathar/appbox:latest was created more than this many days ago. build-appbox runs daily, so a healthy image is less than a day old when the nightly checks it. The tuner moves it one day per week toward the observed rules.age_percentile age, rounded up to whole days, plus rules.age_slack_days.

network_retries.note: Extra attempts the nightly allows each registry operation (skopeo inspect, cosign verify, podman pull) before calling it a failure. The tuner raises it when operations keep succeeding only on their last allowed attempt, and lowers it after a long run of nights where nothing needed a retry.

rules.note: window_runs: how many recent completed nightly runs on main the tuner reads (at most 100). min_runs: below this many runs that recorded measurements it proposes nothing. age_percentile: a percentile, not the maximum, so a few nights of failed builds do not loosen the staleness threshold. raise_retries_when_last_attempt_saves: this many runs where some operation succeeded only on its final allowed attempt raise network_retries by one. lower_retries_after_clean_runs: this many most recent runs with no retry at all lower it by one.
